record.paper_title: Open Problems in Computability Theory and Descriptive Set Theory
record.original_question: If I is a maximal ideal on ω, does there exist a closed I-MED? The paper notes that for this problem it is enough to find a Borel I-MED.

evidence.quote: Problem 49. For maximal ideal I, is there a closed I-MED? For these problems, it is enough to find a Borel I-MED.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in the Baire space ω^ω. Two functions f, g ∈ ω^ω are called eventually different if f(n) ≠ g(n) for all sufficiently large n ∈ ω. A family F ⊆ ω^ω is an eventually different family if any two distinct members of F are eventually different.

Let I be an ideal on ω containing all finite sets. Given f, g ∈ ω^ω, write f =_I g if {n ∈ ω : f(n) = g(n)} ∈ I, and call f, g I-eventually different if {n ∈ ω : f(n) = g(n)} ∈ I (equivalently, the set of agreement is "small" with respect to I). A family F ⊆ ω^ω is an I-eventually different family if any two distinct elements of F are I-eventually different. Such a family F is an I-maximal eventually different family (I-MED) if it is maximal under inclusion among I-eventually different families: for every h ∈ ω^ω there exists f ∈ F with {n : f(n) = h(n)} ∉ I.

Identify ω^ω with its standard Polish topology. Question: If I is a maximal ideal on ω (a non-principal ultrafilter complement, i.e. an ideal whose dual filter is an ultrafilter on ω containing the Fréchet filter), does there exist a closed I-MED in ω^ω?

(It suffices to determine whether there exists a Borel I-MED, since the existence of a Borel I-MED for an ideal I ⊇ fin is known to imply the existence of a closed one.)
artifact.category_tag: Descriptive set theory and combinatorics of ideals
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2024) constructs closed/Borel I-MED families for classes such as F_σ ideals and uniformly weak Ramsey ideals (including fin^α for α < ω₁), but maximal ideals on ω are not in any such class and known constructions do not apply. No source located resolves the question for maximal ideals; it appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Maximal eventually different families for uniformly weak Ramsey ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes existence of closed I-MED for F_σ ideals and fin^α (α<ω₁); does not address maximal ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Positive results known for restricted ideal classes, not for maximal ideals.

status_evidence.title: A closed maximal eventually different family
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a closed MED family for the case I = fin.
status_evidence.claim: Closed MED family known for the Fréchet ideal, leaving general maximal ideals open.
